text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Martial Arts Instruction (Exemption) Notification 1997 and shall come into operation on 1st January 1998.

2. A trainee who —
(a)receives instruction in any form of martial art as part of a course, or other activity, organised or conducted by any martial art association registered under section 4 of the Act;
(b)is not a member of an unlawful society within the meaning of the Societies Act (Cap. 311); and
(c)has not been convicted of any offence that is registrable under the Registration of Criminals Act (Cap. 268),
is exempted from registration as a trainee under section 22 of the Act.
